input.quote: Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Section 17 addresses only what Sparkling must destroy or return to Garman on termination; neither Section 17, the survival clause (Section 18), the escrow clause (Section 16) nor the data-conversion clause (Section 4, which covers conversion at installation only) provides any exit assistance or return/export of Sparkling's data. Searches for transition, exit, export and data return returned no responsive provision, so the rule's clause is absent. We insert the shortest fallback-level provision (expiry or termination trigger, at least 90 days of assistance, export of our data within 30 days), noting the preferred six-month/then-current-rates and certified-deletion mechanics are not pursued.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.

proposal.summary: Insert exit assistance and data export obligation in Section 17
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 17 tells us what we must return to Garman on termination but gives us no exit help or return of our own data, so we have added a short provision at our fallback position: 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days of expiry or termination.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall, at Sparkling's request, provide transition assistance for at least ninety (90) calendar days and, within thirty (30) calendar days after such expiry or termination, export and deliver to Sparkling all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Sparkling.
